messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: auto-page fired -> PD-78432: inference-gateway: spike in HTTP 5xx from us-west1 (alerting threshold 0.5% -> observed 6.8%)

devon: acked — taking lead, standing up triage channel. I can access logs.

maria: seeing pattern -> majority 502 / 504 from edge-proxy -> upstream conn reset. quick grep from proxy logs shows repeated `RST_STREAM` and TLS short record errors.

devon: metric snapshot: `inference-gateway.request_5xx_rate{region="us-west1"}` jumped at 2026-03-15T12:41Z, CPU and request QPS also up ~3x. Noting small spike in concurrent connections to model pool.

incident-bot: PD Update: PD-78432 created, urgency: high, auto-escalation in 8m if unacked. Current responders: @devon (ack), @pd-oncall (notified).

sre_jamie: quick hypothesis — we rolled a keepalive/tcp_reuse tweak in edge-proxy yesterday (commit 9b7c3f) to reduce hanging connections; could be closing sockets too aggressively under burst and upstream H2 clients see `short record` -> 502.

ops_lee: scaling pools now:```bash
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-worker --replicas=12
kubectl -n edge rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy
```Applying, will monitor.

devon: scaled model workers up by +4 but 5xx persisted. After scale the ratio of 502->requests stayed near 5-6%. Logs still show TLS handshake errors and `conn reset by peer`.

maria: paste from edge-proxy stderr:```text
[2026-03-15T12:43:02Z] error: TLS handshake failed: tls: short record
[2026-03-15T12:43:03Z] error: upstream reset: EOF
[2026-03-15T12:43:03Z] warn: conn reuse failed: keepalive timeout expired
```Looks like clients are negotiating and upstream immediately resets.

sre_jamie: can we quickly revert the keepalive change to determine signal? If rollback reduces 5xx then we know config is culprit.

devon: rolling back commit 9b7c3f on edge-proxy config and restarting canary nodes first. Doing canary restart now (edge-canary-1).

maria: FYI customer impact: mobile chat sessions show ~1.8% error rate, web clients ~0.5%. Some retries mask bigger impact for web. Logged support tickets spike for specific customers using older TLS stacks.

product-sam: are paid customers affected? any big ones? need comms if degraded SLA.

maria: early look — a handful of mid-market customers saw session failures; no broad data-plane outage, but chat UX degraded for some. I can compile a quick impact list in 15m.

ops_lee: canary rollback completed on edge-canary-1, waiting for health checks. Command used: `kubectl -n edge set image deploy/edge-proxy edge-proxy=edge-proxy:2026.03.14-rollback && kubectl -n edge rollout status deploy/edge-proxy --watch`

devon: after canary rollback 5xx dropped ~60% on that node's traffic slice. Starting canary-2 rollback.

incident-bot: PD Update: escalated to L2 (sre_jamie) per playbook due to config rollback in prod.

sre_jamie: after reverting keepalive tweak across the fleet, overall 5xx returned to baseline within ~4 minutes. Observed: `inference-gateway.request_5xx_rate` trending back to 0.4%.

devon: verified with synthetic traffic (curl loop) from us-west1 -> no TLS short record now. P95 latency stable.

pd-oncall: taking over checks for next 30m to confirm stability. I'll coordinate postmortem tasking.

maria: opened PD incident notes and customer impact doc: affected ~0.9% of total requests during the window, peak error injection lasted ~18 minutes. Attached list of customer IDs with increased error rates (internal link).

product-sam: thanks. please flag any customers with SLO exposure so we can inform CS.

devon: follow-up actions (short): - revert keepalive tweak permanently until we understand client-side interaction - add synthetic TLS handshake test in us-west1 with varying client TLS stacks - add metric for `edge-proxy.keepalive_failures` - add runbook step: when 5xx spike + TLS short record -> rollback config canary immediately

sre_jamie: agree. I'll own the postmortem and add a remediation timeline. Also we should coordinate with infra team to test kernel tcp_reuse settings under burst.

incident-bot: PD-78432 status changed to resolved by devon. Resolution summary: reverted edge-proxy keepalive/tcp_reuse change (commit 9b7c3f), scaled workers during investigation, reduced 5xx to baseline.

devon: closing thread; leaving notes for SLO and follow-up. If anything regresses ping @sre_jamie or re-open PD. :white_check_mark:
